name: SWAP test
kernel: a 2-register SWAP-test kernel returning fidelity in [0,1] between two amplitude-encoded vectors
ui: a similarity score (0-100%) and a 'closest match' surface

name: QTDA
kernel: a Quantum Topological Data Analysis pipeline returning Betti numbers (b0, b1, b2) from a Vietoris-Rips filtration
ui: a 'shape signature' visualization with connected-component, loop, and void counts

name: Amplitude encoding
kernel: an amplitude-encoding kernel that loads a normalized feature vector into log2(d) qubits and measures expectation values
ui: a low-dimensional embedding scatter that updates as inputs change

name: Grover search
kernel: a Grover oracle that marks valid configurations and returns the sampled solution bitstring after sqrt(N) iterations
ui: a 'found match' panel showing the chosen configuration and confidence

name: QFT
kernel: a Quantum Fourier Transform kernel that returns dominant frequency bins from a sampled signal
ui: a spectral bars view that highlights dominant cycles

name: Quantum walk
kernel: a discrete-time quantum walk on a small graph returning a probability distribution over nodes after t steps
ui: an animated graph where node opacity reflects walk probability

name: Variational ansatz
kernel: a VQE-style parameterized circuit optimized against a style cost Hamiltonian, returning the optimal parameter vector
ui: a slider panel where each slider is one optimized parameter, plus a 'cost over iterations' chart

name: Quantum sampling
kernel: a parameterized circuit sampled for N shots, returning a bitstring distribution used as creative seed noise
ui: a 'regenerate' button that pulls a fresh sample and morphs the output

name: Phase estimation
kernel: a Quantum Phase Estimation kernel returning the dominant eigenphase of a problem operator
ui: a phase dial (0 to 2π) tied to a resonance/match indicator

name: Entanglement
kernel: a Bell-pair / GHZ entanglement kernel that returns correlated measurement outcomes for two players
ui: a two-pane co-creation surface where one side's reveal updates the other in correlated steps
